correctness.rationale: The six-dimensional free-sum gauge is the sum of the two Q gauges, by the convex-combination definition. The last two coordinates uniquely select nonnegative apex weights m/3 and n/2 and leave base scale k-m/3-n/2. This proves the lattice-fiber bijection. An independent replay proposed facet planes with a triangulated hull and then proved completeness in exact arithmetic: the halfspaces contain all inputs, their normals positively span, and all feasible nonsingular triple intersections are exactly the input vertex set. It found 8,11,18 primitive facets at heights 1,3,6. The Q shells were recomputed by counting exact vertical integer intervals in each rational dilation jQ/6. With shell series S(X), the slice counts are coefficients at 6k of S(X)^2/((1-X)(1-X^2)(1-X^3)), so no h* coefficients were assumed. It reproduced all nine lattice counts and all nine coefficients, their sum 6882246, and gamma=(1,4189,191491,825921,246354). Separately, P has the two apex-weight inequalities and 37^2 normalized primitive inequalities from pairs of Q facets; each pair gives a five-dimensional face of B joined to the two apices, hence a facet. The apex-weight facets also have lattice distance one; all paired inequalities have integral normal and right-hand side one after multiplying by six, giving reflexivity. The reciprocal quartic was reconstructed from the coefficients. Its endpoint sign pairs (+,-),(-,+),(+,-),(-,+) on (-5000,-4000),(-50,-40),(-7,-6),(-3,-2) certify four simple roots below -2, which give eight distinct negative roots of h*. The volume is h*(1); the separate determinant-of-apex-displacements factor 6 in the source is also correct.
residual_risks: The proof is specific to the displayed lattice coordinates and standard lattice, not to all eight-dimensional reflexive polytopes. The independent replay does not rely on a floating-point root computation.

value.rationale: This is a specific motivated extremal counterexample, not an arbitrary finite lattice polytope. The exact numerator determines the entire dilate census; the certified eight distinct negative roots add a concrete strong shape property not explained by the facet counterexample or by palindromicity. A researcher comparing Ehrhart shape of known extremal reflexive examples can directly use this invariant.
residual_risks: No general root theorem for extremal reflexive polytopes follows from one example.
